limits: Volatile local admission only; no durability, receipts, distributed recovery, exactly-once, replay safety or cross-owner physical-work guarantee. Circuit bookkeeping retirement does not release a Runner slot, cancel work or revoke an Effect.
A hung live expired recovery holder may stall recovery indefinitely. Ledger bound does not bound OTP mailboxes, total VM memory or upstream reset timers under lifecycle churn.

Trusted truthful observations/monotonic clock, finite static names, consumer supervision, exclusive fuse mutation, fuse/sasl/default ETS stats and bounded caller operations are Needs. Provider identity checks cover observed decision points, not an atomic guarantee against the next crash.

Telemetry is optional synchronous observation; failed handlers detach upstream and slow handlers delay the owner. Consumer Logger/OTP/upstream observations are outside the Piece event redaction contract.

Source consumers reuse upstream artifacts; no cold release build claimed. Root Adapter composition is not exported.
